task.name: Install_camp_fence
task.when: During Build after the camp boundary and service lanes are marked

step.action: Confirm the current fence line, entrances, hardware, and anchor plan in 📦 Build_Book.
Mark the fence line without entering a service lane or emergency exit.
Install each fence section in the printed order.
Secure each section with the listed connections and anchors.
Mark every remaining low anchor, line, or edge visible to pedestrians.

passWhen.criterion: The fence follows the approved line and every planned entrance is open.
Every section, connection, and anchor is installed.
No service lane, emergency exit, or pedestrian route is blocked.
No unmarked trip or sharp-edge hazard remains.
